parts.content:
There’s a BDT 8,200 shortfall on 26 October. First, reduce Supplier A’s order by BDT 10,800; only 12 of the 30 boxes are expected to sell before expiry. Then ask Supplier A for 20 more days on BDT 8,200. Both steps have no stated cost, but the extension is uncertain.

If Supplier A does not agree, the fallback is a mobile-wallet loan of BDT 8,200, costing BDT 181.97. Return claims may bring BDT 9,200 in supplier credit, but they may not arrive in time and don’t count as cash for this shortfall.

These actions are waiting for your approval in Actions.
